places.name: FabEntrance
places.description: Lots created by demand but not yet released into the fab; they wait here for a WIP permit.

places.name: WIPQueue
places.description: Released lots waiting for a chamber. The urgency dynamics raise priority as the due date approaches, and wait_time drives the periodic priority updates.

places.name: BatchQueue
places.description: Lots at a furnace layer waiting to be loaded into a batch. batch_wait accumulates so a partial batch can start on timeout.

places.name: InProcess
places.description: Lots inside a chamber. process_remaining counts down to zero, at which point the chamber holding the lot releases it.

places.name: PostProcess
places.description: Lots that have just finished a step, one layer further on, before routing back to the queue or, at layer 28, to final test.

places.name: InInspection
places.description: Lots on an inspection chamber. The inspection countdown runs like a process step but adds no defects.

places.name: Finished
places.description: Lots that completed all 28 layers with a defect count under scrap_threshold.

places.name: Scrapped
places.description: Lots lost, either failing final test with too many defects or destroyed when their chamber broke down mid-process.

places.name: WIPPermits
places.description: Release permits capping work in progress at wip_cap lots. A release takes one; a finished or scrapped lot returns one.

places.name: ChambersAvailable
places.description: Idle chambers ready to accept a lot, or furnaces still filling a batch. Each carries its condition, particle count, drift, and product qualification.

places.name: ChambersProcessing
places.description: Chambers running a lot or batch. The wear dynamics raise condition and particle count while they run, and the diffusion step injects process noise.

places.name: ChambersInMaintenance
places.description: Chambers with a crew member assigned, counting maintenance_remaining down to recalibration.

places.name: ChambersBroken
places.description: Chambers that need maintenance or failed while no crew member was free; they wait here until one is released.

places.name: MaintenanceCrew
places.description: Technicians free to service or repair a chamber. Each maintenance holds one until it completes.

places.name: MaintenanceEvents
places.description: Cumulative count of maintenance visits, whether preventive or forced by a chamber's condition at the end of a step.

places.name: LotsReleased
places.description: Cumulative count of lots released into the fab.

places.name: LotsCompleted
places.description: Cumulative count of lots that passed final test.

places.name: Calibrations
places.description: Cumulative count of completed maintenances, each of which resets condition and re-centres process drift.

transitions.name: Demand arrives (logic)
transitions.description: Logic lots arrive at half of demand_rate with a 200 hour due date and enter FabEntrance at layer 0.

transitions.name: Demand arrives (memory)
transitions.description: Memory lots arrive at 35% of demand_rate with a 180 hour due date.

transitions.name: Demand arrives (analog)
transitions.description: Analog lots arrive at 15% of demand_rate with a 250 hour due date.

transitions.name: Release lot into fab
transitions.description: Moves a waiting lot into the WIP queue once a WIP permit is free and counts a release.
transitions.lambdaCode: export default Lambda(() => true);

transitions.name: Update lot priority toward deadline
transitions.description: After priority_update_interval hours of waiting, recomputes a queued lot's priority as target_cycle_time over the time left to its due date (10 once overdue, never below 1) and resets its wait clock.

transitions.name: Renegotiate deadline (lot past due)
transitions.description: A lot more than deadline_grace_period hours past its due date gets a new due date one target_cycle_time ahead and its priority reset to 1.

transitions.name: Dispatch lot to litho chamber
transitions.description: Sends a queued lot at a litho layer (0, 4, 9, 12, 16, 20, 24) to an idle litho chamber qualified for its product type, drawing a lognormal process time around litho_time scaled by product type.

transitions.name: Dispatch lot to etch chamber
transitions.description: Sends a queued lot at an etch layer to an idle etch chamber qualified for its product type, drawing a lognormal process time around etch_time scaled by product type.

transitions.name: Lot enters furnace batch queue
transitions.description: A queued lot at a furnace layer (2, 7, 14, 19, 22, 26) moves to the batch queue instead of being dispatched on its own.

transitions.name: Load lot into furnace batch
transitions.description: Loads a batch-queued lot into a qualified furnace chamber with room under batch_size. The chamber stays available while its batch fills; the lot's process time is lognormal around furnace_time.

transitions.name: Start furnace (batch full)
transitions.description: A furnace whose batch_count has reached batch_size starts processing.

transitions.name: Start furnace (batch timeout)
transitions.description: A furnace holding a partial batch starts anyway once one of its loaded lots has waited batch_timeout hours.

transitions.name: Dispatch lot to inspection
transitions.description: Sends a queued lot at an inspection layer (3, 6, 11, 18, 23) to an idle inspection chamber with a lognormal time around inspect_time.

transitions.name: Processing complete, chamber ok
transitions.description: When a lot's countdown ends in its chamber, the lot advances one layer with defects added at base_defect_rate scaled up by the chamber's condition, particle count, and drift, and inherits the chamber's drift as process bias. The chamber returns to available with lots_processed incremented. Fires only while the chamber's condition is under maintenance_threshold.

transitions.name: Furnace lot completes (batch continues)
transitions.description: A finished lot leaves a furnace that still holds other lots of its batch; the chamber keeps processing with batch_count reduced by one.

transitions.name: Processing complete, chamber needs maintenance
transitions.description: As for a healthy chamber, except that condition has reached maintenance_threshold: the lot advances and the chamber goes to ChambersBroken to wait for crew, counting a maintenance event.

transitions.name: Route lot back to WIP queue
transitions.description: A lot below layer 28 returns to the WIP queue for its next step.

transitions.name: Lot passes final test
transitions.description: A lot at layer 28 with defect_count under scrap_threshold is finished; its WIP permit is released and a completion counted.

transitions.name: Lot fails final test
transitions.description: A lot at layer 28 with defect_count at or above scrap_threshold is scrapped and its WIP permit released.

transitions.name: Inspection complete
transitions.description: The inspection countdown ends: the lot advances a layer back to the WIP queue and the chamber returns to available.

transitions.name: Start preventive maintenance
transitions.description: An idle chamber whose condition has reached maintenance_threshold takes a crew member and begins a lognormal maintenance_duration.

transitions.name: Maintenance complete (drift recalibrated)
transitions.description: Maintenance ends: condition resets to 0, particles to 0.05, and process_drift is re-centred within calibration_residual. The crew member is freed and a calibration counted.

transitions.name: Chamber breakdown
transitions.description: A litho, etch, or inspection chamber fails mid-run at breakdown_base_rate grown exponentially with condition. The lot inside is scrapped and its WIP permit released; a free crew member starts a lognormal breakdown_repair_time repair at once.

transitions.name: Chamber breakdown (no crew available)
transitions.description: The same failure hazard when no crew member is free: the lot is scrapped and the chamber waits in ChambersBroken.

transitions.name: Crew reaches broken chamber
transitions.description: A freed crew member takes on a broken chamber and starts its repair, keeping any repair time already assigned.
transitions.lambdaCode: export default Lambda(() => true);

transitions.name: Process noise injection (diffusion step)
transitions.description: Every diffusion_step hours a processing chamber's particle count and process drift take a Gaussian step scaled by their volatilities, the stochastic half of the drift that the wear dynamics revert.

types.name: Lot
types.description: A wafer lot: product type (0 logic, 1 memory, 2 analog), current layer of 28, priority, age, accumulated defects, remaining process time, wait and batch clocks, due date, process bias, and the chamber holding it (tool_id times 100 plus chamber index, or -1).

types.name: Chamber
types.description: A process chamber within a tool: machine group (0 litho, 1 etch, 2 furnace, 3 inspection), tool and chamber index, product qualification, and its state: condition, particle count, hours since maintenance, maintenance countdown, diffusion clock, lots processed, process drift, and furnace batch count.

Clock: process countdown (+ age)

Particle count that doubles the wear rate

title: Semiconductor fab — process drift & multi-chamber tools (v3)
description: A wafer fab as a dynamic coloured net: lots of three product types cycle through 28 layers across litho, etch, furnace, and inspection chambers grouped into multi-chamber tools. Chambers degrade, gather particles, and drift continuously; the defects a step adds scale with that state, and maintenance recalibrates a chamber at the cost of taking it and a crew member out of service.
